A clean 2D cartoon illustration in a simple, minimal cartoon style with a flat digital look.

Scene: same small bedroom home office, daytime, warm soft natural light.
Camera: medium shot, slightly low angle, dynamic framing.

Characters: 1 stick-figure character with a BIG ROUND HEAD that is ALWAYS PURE WHITE, tiny dot eyes, minimal simple mouth, raised eyebrows. The body is simple and minimal. Arms, legs, and hands are BLACK stick-line outlines, not filled. Clothes and accessories are simple flat shapes with solid fills: blue hoodie, dark pants, black headphones.

Action: the young man raises both arms in celebration after seeing a notification for his first design sale on the laptop, mood is joyful and surprised.

Background: simple clean shapes, flat muted colors, solid fills, crisp edges, uniform line weight, no visible brush strokes, no paper texture, no sketchy lines, clean readable composition.
